name: Alicia Viewstream
original_name: アリシア・ビューストレーム
source:
Commander of the Cordelia army. Regent and Duchess of Cordelia.
A talented woman with the beauty and charisma of a champion.
After the assassination the Archduke and the Marquis (her father and uncle), she became the guardian of her successor and cousin, Maya Cordelia, and has since led Cordelia to become a military power with great influence on the Neo-Terras and New Solars.
As the hero of Cordelia, she is immensely popular with her subjects, and is revered as a true warrior who is loyal to Maya, despite practically ruling the country.
As a soldier, she serves as the Captain of Cordelia's own invented forces, the Armored Cavalry Force, and is a known as a brave general who takes command of the front line herself.

She dotes on Maya, and supports her every way to make her a worthy Archduke. She more of a mother than a cousin. 
As a result of the battle between the Neo-Terras and the New Solar, she decided to ally with the latter. Due to this, the aura of Donny Bohgan soon comes.
